::: {#sol-best-constant}

In @eq-constant-prediction-decompose,
the first term, $\Var{Y}$, does not depend on $c$.
The second term, $\sqf{\mean - c}$, is a square, so it is never negative,
and it is zero exactly when $c = \mean$.
So

$$
\begin{aligned}
c &= \mean \\
&= \E{Y}
\end{aligned}
$$

minimizes the [expected](expectation.qmd#def-expectation) squared error,
and no other number does.
In the notation of the [argmin](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-basics.html#def-argmin),
the set of minimizers has the single element $\mean$.

:::
